AN EDUCATIONAL FOUNDATION

THE PSI UPSILON FOUNDATION. INC

Some pertinent data:

History

Two or three years ago several outstanding Psi U'sWeed of the Theta Chapter;
Babst of the Iota-Phi; Burton of the Chi; Richards of the Sigma; Burleigh of the
Zeta; Brush of the Delta Delta; June MerriU of the Gamma, and Morton of the
Omicron, finaUy secured the legal papers for the formal setting up of the Psi Upsilon
Foundation, Inc., with the documented internal revenue agreement that gifts made
to it were legal deductions from
gross income, with the usual statutory limitations.
This was accomphshed only after the yeoman service of Brother Ed Richards of the
Sigma Chapter Alumni. This was an important milestone in the history of Psi U and
lays firm groundwork for optimism for the future.

Our measurements fo qualify for Foundation aid:

University scholastic average, or better;
Strong evidence of leadership;
Devotion to country, college, family, and fraternity;
Participation in college and fraternity activities;
Man of purpose and ambition;
Man of high moral reputation and great integrity;
A brother who truly needs aid, or whose receipt of same would inspire him to
even
greater achievements.

How to give

Younger brothers

Through annual giving in modest amounts.

Older brothers

Through lump sum giving
Through lump sum pledge with annual payments
Through lump sum gift payable quarterly or semi annually
Through setting up Trust fund with Foundation, income to go to you or
designated beneficiaries for lffe (This is a major estate tax exemption.)
Through testamentary giving.

8

THE DIAMOND OF PSI EPSILON 9

Gifts of securities or property
Every donor, whether he gives modestly or substantially, can save money, or give
more
generously at the same cost, by giving securities which have increased in value
since purchase rather than cash. The increase in value is not subject to capital gains
tax; the market value of the securities at the time of the gift measures the amount
which is deductible, subject to federal and state tax law limitations. The fact that
your securities may be more than the exact denomination you wish to give makes no
difference. Simply send your certificate to the Treasurer with instructions as to the
number of shares you wish returned. The Foundation wiU send you a new certificate
for those shares.
Gifts of real property offer the same general advantages as gffts of securities.
There are added advantages if such property consists of business real estate on
which depreciation has been taken. The gift can be spread over a period of years, if
necessary, to secure maximum gift deduction. If it is not obliged to keep or main
tain the property, the Foundation, under many circumstances, is prepared to accept

gifts of real property. Before making such a gift, the prospective donor should con
sult the Foundation.
